name: Dialog
rows: Wh-what? You all don't like pirates? Say it isn't so!
Argh... I'll try harder next time.
Haha! That should have been enough for everyone to feel.
Good job. Why don't you and I go get a drink?
What do you think, Master Captain? What a grand adventure we've had together!
Yo ho ho! This is the happiest day of my life!
It's okay, Master. I'll give you a starfish, so cheer up.
Mast would be disappointed. I'll try harder.
I've worked up a real appetite. Let's go eat.
Look at all these customers. Maybe we should try running a business on the Admire too.
If this is your idea of adventure, it seems like it'll be a real blast!
Not exactly the results I was looking for, but here are 5 bonus points for effort.
Hmm... There were too many rude customers this time around.
Hehe, that was fun in its own way. Let's keep at it for the next shift.
What an invigorating feeling... this must be the reward you get for hard work.
You performed admirably, so here are 50 bonus points.
I worked pretty hard. Don't you want to grant me a wish?
